fields.contract: TvpExpressionHelpers compiles table-valued-record (SqlDataRecord) column metadata (SqlMetaData) and row-assignment expressions for MapToSql*Attribute properties, used both directly and when MapToSqlTableValuedParameterAttribute binds collection properties to table-valued parameters. For each previously unseen normalized column name, a plan adds one SqlMetaData entry and one conditional assignment guarded by IncludeThisColumn; duplicate normalized column names add neither metadata nor assignments. Behavior by builder family: (1) TvpStringExpressionBuilder preserves declared Length and converts enum / Nullable<enum> values via ToString(); (2) TvpEnumXIntExpressionBuilder handles integer and enum columns (BigInt/Int64, Int/Int32, SmallInt/Int16, TinyInt/Byte), performing unchecked same-width Expression.Convert conversions for ulong/ulong? -> long, uint/uint? -> int, ushort/ushort? -> short, and sbyte/sbyte? -> byte, as well as converting any enum (on BigInt, Int, SmallInt, TinyInt) and any Nullable<enum> (on Int, SmallInt, TinyInt, regardless of underlying integer type) to the destination base integer type; (3) TvpDateValueExpressionBuilder and TvpTimeValueExpressionBuilder convert DateOnly/DateOnly? to midnight DateTime (SetDateTime) and TimeOnly/TimeOnly? to TimeSpan (SetTimeSpan); (4) TvpGuidFloatingPointExpressionBuilder writes Guid, double, and float values, mapping Guid.Empty and NaN (as well as null Nullable<T>) to SetDBNull; (5) TvpBinaryExpressionBuilder supports both byte[] and fixed-width big-endian binary encoding (8, 4, 2, and 1 bytes via ExpressionHelpers.NumericBinaryEncodeExpression and NumericBinaryConverter) for ulong, uint, ushort, and sbyte (and their nullable forms) on MapToSqlBinaryAttribute and MapToSqlVarBinaryAttribute (whose IsValidType validators enforce width via InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException and InvalidMapTypeException, while runtime decoding enforces payload width via InvalidBinaryValueLengthException). Null reference values and empty Nullable<T> values map to SetDBNull. Note that while TVP and scalar/binary SQL mappings support ulong, uint, ushort, and sbyte, ShardKey serialization does not support those four types.
fields.name: TvpExpressionHelpers table-valued record assignment compiler
